decisions.decision: Start with source annotations and metadata only; retain the 30-cell and three-independent-unit defaults.
decisions.reason: Eligibility must not depend on a candidate gene-program score.
decisions.prior_exposure: Existing lung studies and ES1 results already inspected; no A0 expression program learned.

decisions.decision: Do not use the local GSE262927 author-defined Alveolar_transitional cohort as primary discovery at the current floor.
decisions.reason: Only one annotated animal has at least 30 AT2, Alveolar_transitional and AT1 cells. AT1_AT2 is reported separately, not merged to improve coverage.

decisions.decision: Keep GSE254356 as a biological reference; replicated discovery eligibility remains unresolved.
decisions.reason: GEO exposes two EPCAM/ICAM-enriched libraries and one EPCAM library. The paper's n=3 does not establish three independent identically sampled state comparisons. Embryonic pooling and cell-to-library annotation are unresolved.

decisions.decision: Audit one alternative repair study and two linked developmental resources without downloading expression matrices.
decisions.reason: Resolve concrete coverage and replication gaps in the first candidates. The core analysis remains capped at three selected settings.

decisions.decision: Prioritize GSE141259 enriched epithelium for a possible D1 replacement, pending animal independence and time-design review.
decisions.reason: Ten libraries have complete triplets at the existing floor, across multiple days. Same-day replication is at most two. A paired analysis across a biologically specified time window is a candidate design, not a frozen or executed analysis.

decisions.decision: Audit GSE92332 using the published matrix header and source-explicit mouse mappings only.
decisions.reason: The ten batches are not ten biological replicates. Four control mice map explicitly to B3, B4, B7 and B8, including a documented typo in the B3 source title. Other batch-to-mouse relationships are not inferred.

decisions.decision: Treat Stem to immature-proximal-enterocyte to mature-proximal-enterocyte as an exploratory V1 eligibility branch only.
decisions.reason: Only two of four mapped mice pass the state floor. State selection used author labels and coverage, not expression scores; transition evidence and full mouse mapping remain unresolved. No program test or validation claim is made.

decisions.decision: Do not freeze P1 or start P2 from the current candidate set.
decisions.reason: The intended three-setting design lacks a fully eligible developmental cohort and a fully eligible transfer cohort. This is unresolved feasibility, not a negative biological result. The initial bounded candidate audit is complete; cohort selection is not.

decisions.decision: Repair interval comparisons are feasible without three mice on the same day.
decisions.reason: Strunz primary methods report separate replicate mice. Nine available complete triplets fall within candidate days 10-15, excluding NC-labeled controls. The available annotation version has 32 libraries versus 36 mice in the paper. No expression outcomes were inspected and P1 remains unfrozen.

decisions.decision: Do not use age-pooled developmental labels as replicated discovery observations.
decisions.reason: The public Negretti viewer contains 10918 epithelial cells in 14 barcode-suffix groups. Only one group passes all floors; grouping by age would conceal the shortage. Mouse/hash IDs are omitted and suffix-to-library identities remain provisional.

decisions.decision: Retain the intestinal mapping and coverage gap.
decisions.reason: The supplementary table provides dataset totals, not the remaining mouse-to-batch map. Two of four verified mice pass the proposed branch. No unmapped batch is treated as an independent animal.

decisions.decision: Audit the planned normal-skin fallback but leave eligibility unresolved.
decisions.reason: GEO provides 1422 cells in 34 capture batches; the paper reports 19 mice. No reliable mouse-to-batch mapping was recovered. Absence of a recovered mapping is not proof it does not exist.

decisions.decision: Add explicitly illustrative capture planning, separate from expression-effect power.
decisions.reason: Use observed pooled epithelial fractions and a binomial union bound to find the smallest retained-cell target with at least 95 percent modeled triplet capture; include a halved-intermediate-fraction scenario. No state floor was changed.

decisions.decision: Close the bounded feasibility audit; retain P1-P4 as blocked, not completed.
decisions.reason: D2 and V1 have no qualifying selected cohorts. Learning from repair alone or manufacturing replication would change the scientific question. No conservation or specificity result is available. Additional eligible inputs or a future documented redesign are required.

decisions.decision: User authorized stepwise repair-first expression analysis with explicit proceed/stop reviews.
decisions.reason: Allow an informative descriptive pilot despite unresolved replication for the original three-context design.
decisions.scope: Nine repair mice for discovery; development and intestine used only for frozen descriptive transfer.

decisions.decision: Narrow rather than expand after executed discovery, specificity, transfer and targeted depth sensitivity.
decisions.reason: Repair signal robust; broad primary transfer unsupported; control-variant intestinal lead is depth-sensitive.
